body.prompt: Photorealistic industrial design photograph of a daily-carry aerial camera quadcopter. Orthographic 90-degree overhead, nose at twelve o'clock. True X, four motors, arms at 45 degrees to the nose axis, square hub layout, opposite hubs 250 mm apart. Four stationary propellers, each a single balanced pair of opposite equal blades, 125 mm tip to tip. Compact bevelled body, 1.6:1. A narrower transverse camera cartridge nests between short nose lugs; a fine parting seam and its satin metal end caps remain visible from above. Four separate arms seat flush in recessed shoulder sockets, each with one fitted collar. Tight joints and two banks of inset cooling slots. Satin warm-grey molded shell, graphite composite arms, charcoal blades. Soft 5500 K sidelight, defined contact shadows, pale seamless background. Use the four reference endpoints for motor locations. Unlettered product, full aircraft in frame.
